text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a billing spike for our inference pools in eu-west-1 this week. Commitments look underutilized; also high inter-region egress when we failover to us-central. Anyone else seeing this?

alex: saw the same. raw numbers: eu-west-1 p4d equivalent effective rate ~ $8.50/GPU-hr on on-demand vs committed $4.20/GPU-hr (1yr RI). egress: ~ $0.09/GB cross-region. rough math shows >30% unit cost increase when we failover heavy KV cache refresh.

samir: can you paste the query? I want to check the commit utilization window.

maria: paste: ```sql
SELECT region, sum(gpu_hours) as used, reserved_hours
FROM billing.gpu_commitments
WHERE period >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY region;
``` shows eu-west used 62% of reserved last 90d.

alex: interesting — ap-southeast-1 is 48% used. us-central is 92% used (hot). if we shift batch/low-latency background work to us-central we reduce unit cost but increase cross-region network egress for responses.

priya: latency SLOs for EU customers are 50ms p95. Shifting inference will break that for interactive traffic, but we can shift embeddings and offline rerank.

samir: what about mixing reserved SKUs across regions? Some clouds allow borrowing within zone families if same commitment type but different region — we should check contract.

finance-bot: FYI flagged: potential overcommit penalty if utilization < 60% for eu-west commitments next invoice.

maria: ops proposal: 1) move 30% of non-interactive batch inference from eu-west->us-central for 4 weeks, 2) right-size eu-west reserved from current to 0.7x at next renewal, 3) validate egress delta. Anyone object?

alex: +1. I'd also add an automatic routing rule to prefer local cache hits and only route to other regions when cache miss and latency budget allows.

priya: ok, schedule canary for Tuesday 03:00 UTC. I'll own runbook and dashboard.

maria: thanks. action items: @priya runbook, @samir check contract borrowing, @finance-bot confirm penalty calc. I'll open a Jira.

samir: will ping legal/cloud for borrowing rules.

priya: putting timings in calendar. :shipit:

maria: closing loop next Wed. :thumbsup:
